# Nullbox

> Nullbox is a small, deliberately silly support ticketing system: customers report problems,
> support workers answer them, and everyone works toward Inbox Zero while the Backlog Beast watches.

## Pages

- [New ticket](https://team-06.fasthacks.cloud/): customers describe what broke and file a ticket
- [Worker inbox](https://team-06.fasthacks.cloud/inbox): support workers triage and answer open tickets

## API

- [Health check](https://team-06.fasthacks.cloud/api/healthz): JSON API under `/api`, returns `{"status":"ok"}`
- [Source code and API docs](https://github.com/golden-wizards/nullbox): Rust/axum API and React web app
